articles.summary: NioCorp reports the results of an updated 2026 Feasibility Study for its Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project outlining the project’s evolution into a 40-year, integrated U.S. operation with a Net Present Value exceeding $4 billion that is expected to produce eight critical-mineral products from a single ore body.
articles.title: NioCorp Project to Expand Production to 8 Made-in-USA Critical Minerals Over a 40-Year Mine Life with an Estimated $4.1 Billion Pre-Tax NPV8%¹

articles.summary: NioCorp will host a live webcast on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET to discuss the results of its updated feasibility study for the Elk Creek Critical Minerals Project.
articles.title: NioCorp to Host Webcast on Aug. 11 to Discuss Elk Creek Feasibility Study Results

articles.summary: NioCorp announced the signing of an MOU with Lockheed Martin regarding the potential purchase of up to 15 tonnes/year of scandium oxide from NioCorp, in either oxide form or in the form of aluminum-scandium alloys, over the next 10 years.
articles.title: Lockheed Martin and NioCorp Sign MOU
